notes.title: Design your own plays, coach records and the Hall of Fame

items.text: Play designer. Open Edit playbook and press Design a play: drag your eleven into place, give each player a job, and click the field to draw routes and running lanes.
Defense designer. Place your eleven defenders and tell each one to rush, cover a man, drop to a zone or read the play.
The game checks every design against the rules and tells you in plain words what to fix, such as too few players on the line.
Practice field. Run a design dozens of times against any defense (or any play) and see average gain, completions, sacks and turnovers. Watch one to see it on the real field.
Keep up to 12 plays and 6 defenses of your own. Your plays go in your eight-play book; your defenses are under the Mine tab on defense.
Your designs come with you into online games. The server checks them again, and both coaches see the same play.
Coach profile. Every finished online game counts toward your career wins, losses, points and best winning streak. Championships will count once dynasty seasons arrive.
Hall of Fame. The ten best records among all online coaches, one button from the menu.
Coverage now lines up against the formation in front of it, so corners follow receivers wherever you put them.
Known gap: a very carefully built custom play can still gain more than it should against the AI. Tightening that is ongoing.
Talk to the other coach during an online game. Press Voice chat in the lobby or on the sideline bar and allow your microphone.
Audio goes straight from one browser to the other. It never passes through the game server, and it is free.
Mute your mic at any time; the status line shows whether you are connected. Voice carries on from the lobby into the game.
Play a friend online. Sign in with a coach name and a four-digit PIN, host a game, and share the five-digit game PIN. The other coach types it in to join.
Hidden play calls: you only see that the other sideline has called its play, never what it is, until the snap.
The server runs every play. Both browsers replay it from the shared record and check that they match the server exactly.
If a coach drops out, the AI calls his plays so nobody is left waiting. He can sign back in on any device and pick up where the game is.
Depth chart and game plan changes work online, and your own eight-play book comes with you.
The site now publishes itself when an update is merged.
A 24-play library across five formations: Singleback, I-Form, Shotgun, Spread and Heavy, with lead blockers, quarterback runs and a sneak.
Build your own playbook: pick the eight plays you carry into the game. Your book is remembered on your device.
Four defensive fronts (4-3, 5-2, Nickel, 3-4), each with four calls. Man coverage now matches up against whatever formation lines up.
Full 39-player rosters with depth charts. Players tire as they play, slow down, and are rested automatically; reorder your depth chart from the sideline.
A 20-second play clock. If it runs out, your AI coach makes the call from your game plan: run or pass lean, and how bold to be on fourth down.
Kneel-downs to run out the clock.
A sharper AI coach: kneels to finish a win, plays prevent defense with a late lead, brings the heavy front on the goal line and chases two points when the score calls for it.
Balance: over 200 simulated games, no play averages more than 1.5 times the playbook average, and a wrong defensive guess hurts without deciding the game.

notes.title: Start screen, logo and this site

items.text: Friday Night Dynasty start screen and logo.
This website, with dev notes and the roadmap. The game's title screen shows its version from the same notes file.
The home side is now the Wildcats, in navy, white and red to match the artwork.
Build order changed: online head-to-head moves up to right after play calling, and the league is built online-first so friends can coach rival schools from the first season.
A full four-quarter exhibition game. You call the plays; the AI controls all 22 players and coaches the other sideline.
Starter playbook: 8 offensive plays and 4 defensive calls, each with a diagram. Guess the offense right and your defense gets an edge.
Coach's decisions: punt, field goal, extra point or two-point try, and timeouts.
Watch at normal speed, fast, or skip to the result. Scoring plays and turnovers you fast-forwarded are replayed at normal speed.
Kickoffs, punts, field goals, safeties, interceptions, fumbles and sacks, with a score bug and a final summary.
Every game is reproducible from its seed and the list of coaching decisions, which is what will make online results fair.
Game design, architecture plan, data model and acceptance criteria for every milestone.
Direction set: coach-only. Nobody steers a player; every decision is a coach's decision.

roadmap.title: Exhibition football
roadmap.text: Coach a full game against the AI. Playable now; waiting on playtest sign-off.

roadmap.title: Playbooks and smarter football
roadmap.text: A 24-play library, build-your-own book, four defensive fronts, fatigue and substitutions, a play clock and a game plan. Playable now.

roadmap.title: Online head-to-head
roadmap.text: Invite a friend with a game PIN and coach against each other live, with hidden play calls. Playable now on the website.

roadmap.title: Sideline voice chat
roadmap.text: Talk to the other coach during an online game, free and straight from your browser. Playable now on the website.

roadmap.title: Design your own plays
roadmap.text: Draw up offensive and defensive plays in an editor, test them on a practice field, and carry them into games. Playable now.

roadmap.title: Coach profile and Hall of Fame
roadmap.text: Career wins, losses and championships for every online coach, and a top-ten Hall of Fame. Records count now; championships arrive with dynasty seasons.

roadmap.title: Bigger playbook and special teams
roadmap.text: A 20-play starter book, plus special-teams calls: onside and squib kicks, fake punts and field goals, and going for the block.

roadmap.title: Game length options
roadmap.text: Choose how long the four quarters are before kickoff.

roadmap.title: Complete statistics
roadmap.text: Full box scores for teams and players, checked so every number adds up.

roadmap.title: Eight-school league
roadmap.text: Pick a real state and get a generated league of eight fictional schools with rosters, rivals, schedules and standings. Any school can be run by a person or the AI.

roadmap.title: Dynasty seasons with friends
roadmap.text: Persistent rosters and week-by-week seasons. Invite coaches to run rival schools; the week advances when everyone is ready.

roadmap.title: Kids grow up
roadmap.text: Graduation, incoming freshmen from feeder schools, player development, morale and academics.

roadmap.title: Run the program
roadmap.text: Coaching staff, facilities, fundraising and community expectations.

roadmap.title: Playoffs and championships
roadmap.text: League, section and state brackets, with overtime.

roadmap.title: Commissioner tools
roadmap.text: Advance and roll back weeks, assign coaches, set schedules and keep an audit log.

roadmap.title: Records, alumni and legacy
roadmap.text: Record books, hall of fame, college offers, and a coaching career with job offers.

roadmap.title: Regional and national
roadmap.text: More states, showcase games, rankings and a fictional national championship.

roadmap.title: Weather
roadmap.text: Rain, wind, cold and heat that change how the ball is thrown, kicked and held on to.
